note: slug and urlPath are IDENTITY — a urlPath never rotates on save or rebuild; only bin/docsite-new.mjs mints one. Removing a doc removes entry + page + source in one commit. Draft and hidden documents are listed in the private docsite manifest (lib/docsite-roots.mjs), never here.

docs.note: Every class, in family and number order, one row each — no argument, no edition history, no filters. Generated by bin/taxonomy-render.mjs from monitor/failure-taxonomy.json; regenerate with that command, never hand-edit. Self-styled (own light/dark THEME, print CSS) rather than the docsite shell, so the same file is also the PDF source.

docs.title: commitwork Coverage Survey
docs.note: Recovered from evaluations/arch-view-2026-08-29/commitwork-coverage-survey.recovered.html, which was a `cat -n`-style dump: 896 of 897 lines carried a literal N<TAB> line-number prefix that would have rendered as visible garbage. Verified lossless BEFORE stripping — the prefixes ran 2..897 with zero sequence breaks, proving no content line began with digits+TAB. Three Google Fonts CDN links removed to satisfy the self-contained-artifact invariant; every font-family already declared a full system fallback stack, so the strip degrades to system fonts rather than breaking layout. Staged FLAT (imported/<slug>.html), matching taxonomy and taxonomy-reference: bin/docsite-build.mjs builds its orphan set from `kind === 'md'` urlPaths only, so an imported doc staged as a directory under pages/ is reported as an orphan and the build refuses. Cloudflare Pages answers the /<slug>/ form for a flat <slug>.html, which is the addressing bin/test/cloudflare-purge.test.mjs already assumes for /taxonomy/.
